claims.statement: The function `mapAanvraagToSpottCreateRequest` maps an AanvraagRecord to a SpottCreateVacancyRequest by setting: - clientContactIds to an empty array - companyId to a fixed fixture ID ("company-fixture-001") - description to the aanvraag's beschrijving plus an optional contact persons block (as per CTP-610) - employmentType to "contract" - endAt to null - location to null - locationType to "remote" - name to the aanvraag's titel - salaryRange to null - stageId to a fixed fixture ID ("stage-fixture-001") - startAt to null - targetCompanyId to null - teamUserIds to an empty array
